content: But more fundamentally, our work provides the necessary tool to study the question of how “characteristic-ness" or novelty are related to tweet popularity. Do tweets that are more characteristic of the user get more likes, replies and retweets? Is such a relationship universal, or does it depend upon the personality or domain of the author? Twitter users with a large follower base can employ our methods to understand how characteristic a new potential tweet sounds, and obtain an estimate of how popular it is likely to become.
